description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for a 'capitalize' modifier, which capitalizes words in a string with options for handling digits and case of rest of the string.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize
methods.description: Main function to capitalize words in a string with options for uppercase digits and lowercase rest.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_mbconvert_cb
methods.description: Callback for converting matched text to uppercase using mb_convert_case.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_mbconvert2_cb
methods.description: Callback for converting matched text to uppercase with different capturing groups.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_ucfirst_cb
methods.description: Callback to uppercase the first character of a match.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_ucfirst2_cb
methods.description: Callback to uppercase the first character of a different match group.
